title: SmartGSN: an online tool to semi-automatically manage assurance cases

live_model.evidence: "our tool offers users the choice between two LLMs (i.e. GPT-4o and GPT-4 Turbo)"; Table 2 row "BLUEROV2 GPT-4 Turbo 0.5 1 0.67..." (R/P/FM, avg. of 5 runs).

prompt.location: Sec. 3 (metric-based prompting rule, referencing prior work [19] for exact technique)
prompt.note: SmartGSN assembles a prompt from a system's domain knowledge and a chosen assurance-case pattern; full technique detailed in a separate prior paper, not fully self-contained here.

claim.metric: F-Measure, defeater/case generation for the BLUEROV2 system

data.source: five public assurance-case studies (ACAS XU, BLUEROV2, GPCA, IM Software, DeepMind), standard examples in the assurance-case literature

notes: Table 1 reports dataset statistics (placeholders/GSN elements per pattern) but an exact item count usable as n_items was not located in the reviewed excerpt; results are averaged over five runs per threshold.
